title: Finite purely inseparable field extension
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $k'/k$ a field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. If $k$ has characteristic $p>0$, an element $\alpha\in k'$ is *purely inseparable* over $k$ if $\alpha^{p^n}\in k$ for some $n\ge0$, and $k'/k$ is *purely inseparable* if every element of $k'$ is; in characteristic $0$, $k'/k$ is purely inseparable if $k'=k$. The extension is *finite* if $k'$ is a finite-dimensional $k$-vector space.
